name: chdir
description: chdir() changes the current working directory of the calling process to the directory specified in path. fchdir() is identical to chdir(), but the directory is specified using an open file descriptor.

parameters.name: path
parameters.description: Path to the new working directory

return_value.failure: Returns -1 on error, and errno is set

errors.description: Search permission is denied for one of the components of path.
path points outside your accessible address space.
Too many symbolic links were encountered in resolving path.
The directory specified in path does not exist.
A component of path is not a directory.
Search permission was denied on the directory open on fd.
fd is not a valid file descriptor.
